mapper.sql: id, parent_id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, path, component, icon, sort_order, ext_info, deleted, last_modifier, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
select
from (SELECT sp.* FROM sys_permission sp WHERE sp.permission_type < 3 AND ( -- 逻辑 A：当前用户是否拥有超级管理员角色 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role sur ON su.id = sur.user_id JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.id WHERE su.login_account = #{loginAccount} AND sr.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) OR -- 逻辑 B：如果不是超管，检查当前权限是否在用户的角色关联中 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role sur ON su.id = sur.user_id JOIN sys_role_permission srp ON sur.role_id = srp.role_id WHERE su.login_account = #{loginAccount} AND srp.permission_id = sp.id ) ) ) as sp order by sp.parent_id, sp.sort_order
